# Tax Documentation: Submit W-8BEN Tax Documentation Data

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`POST /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/w-8ben` · tenant-scoped token

Submit W-8BEN tax documentation data for an account owner. This endpoint allows you to collect and store W-8BEN form information required for tax reporting and compliance for non-U.S. individuals. An individual is a U.S. Person if they are a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident or have met the Substantial Presence Test. A business is a U.S. Person if they are organized or incorporated in the U.S.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

**Shape 1: Substitute Form**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | The legal name of the account owner. |
| `country` | string | No | Country identifier — an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or one of the supported IRS-only codes (for example `FQ`, `WZ`) or territory names (for example `BURMA`, `SVALBARD`) used where the IRS code collides with an ISO alpha-2 for a different country. See the enum for the full list. One of 272 values: see [values/country-of-citizenship.md](../values/country-of-citizenship.md). |
| `permanent_address` | object | No | The account owner's permanent residence address, used to determine their country of tax residency for W-8BEN purposes. This should reflect where the individual physically resides and is not a P.O. box or in-care-of address. |
| `permanent_address.first_line` | string | No | The first line of the address. |
| `permanent_address.second_line` | string | No | The second line of the address. |
| `permanent_address.city` | string | No | The city. |
| `permanent_address.state_or_province` | one of several shapes | No | The state or province (US state, Canada province, or other) |
| `permanent_address.postal_code` | string | No | The postal code. |
| `permanent_address.country` | string | No | Country identifier — an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or one of the supported IRS-only codes (for example `FQ`, `WZ`) or territory names (for example `BURMA`, `SVALBARD`) used where the IRS code collides with an ISO alpha-2 for a different country. See the enum for the full list. One of 272 values: see [values/country-of-citizenship.md](../values/country-of-citizenship.md). |
| `mailing_address` | object | No | An optional mailing address for the account owner, used if correspondence should be sent to a location different from their permanent residence address. |
| `mailing_address.first_line` | string | No | The first line of the address. |
| `mailing_address.second_line` | string | No | The second line of the address. |
| `mailing_address.city` | string | No | The city. |
| `mailing_address.state_or_province` | one of several shapes | No | The state or province (US state, Canada province, or other) |
| `mailing_address.postal_code` | string | No | The postal code. |
| `mailing_address.country` | string | No | Country identifier — an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or one of the supported IRS-only codes (for example `FQ`, `WZ`) or territory names (for example `BURMA`, `SVALBARD`) used where the IRS code collides with an ISO alpha-2 for a different country. See the enum for the full list. One of 272 values: see [values/country-of-citizenship.md](../values/country-of-citizenship.md). |
| `us_tin` | string | No | The taxpayer's US tax identification number. |
| `ftin` | string | No | The taxpayer's foreign tax identification number. |
| `date_of_birth` | string (date) | No | Date of birth, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| `reference_numbers` | string | No | Reference number(s) if any. |
| `ftin_not_legally_required` | boolean | No | Indicates whether the foreign tax identification number is not legally required. If true, a ftin should not be provided. |
| `has_signed_and_certified` | boolean | No | Indicates whether the form has been signed and certified by the account owner. |
| `signature_timestamp` | string (date-time) | No | The timestamp when the form was signed (ISO 8601 format) |
| `completed_for` | string | No | Indicates for whom the tax documentation form is completed. One of: `ACCOUNT_HOLDER`, `REGARDED_OWNER`. |
| `treaty_claim_is_eligible` | boolean | No | Indicates whether the account owner is eligible to claim treaty benefits. Deprecated: this is derived from the presence of treaty_claim_country and no longer needs to be sent. **Deprecated.** |
| `treaty_claim_country` | string | No | The country for which the account owner is claiming treaty benefits on the W-8BEN form. This must be a country that maintains an active income tax treaty with the United States and with which the individual has a valid tax residency tie. One of 272 values: see [values/country-of-citizenship.md](../values/country-of-citizenship.md). |
| `treaty_claim_i_certify_resident` | boolean | No | Certifies that the account owner is a resident of the country where they are claiming treaty benefits. |
| `treaty_claim_type_of_income` | string | No | The type of income being claimed for treaty benefits. One of: `BUSINESS_PROFITS`, `DIVIDENDS`, `INTEREST`, `OTHER_INCOME`, `ROYALTIES_MOTION_PICTURE_AND_TV`, `ROYALTIES_OTHER`. |
| `treaty_claim_rate_of_withholding` | string | No | The rate of withholding on the type of income. **Note:** The percentage as a plain number string, without a % sign: `"0"`, `"5"`, `"15"`. |
| `treaty_claim_article_paragraph` | string | No | The article and paragraph of the tax treaty. **Note:** The treaty's article reference only, without the words "Article" or "Paragraph": for example `12(1)`, `7(1)`, `21`, or `10(2)(b)`. It must match the reference Taxbit holds exactly for the treaty country and type of income; the docs' sample "Article 12, Paragraph 1" is rejected. If the claim comes back `INCOMPLETE_TREATY_CLAIM` with "not an acceptable value", the reference is wrong for that country and income type. |
| `treaty_claim_has_additional_conditions` | boolean | No | Indicates whether there are additional conditions under the treaty. **Note:** `true` when the treaty requires the claimant to meet additional conditions for this claim. Business profits and other income always do; royalties depend on the country. If the claim comes back saying additional conditions "must be checked", set it to `true`. |
| `signature` | string | No | The name signed on the form. Requires `has_signed_and_certified` to be true. When omitted, Taxbit derives the signature from `name` for individuals and stores a placeholder for entities. |

```json
{"name":"John Doe","us_tin":"123456789","ftin":"FTIN123456","date_of_birth":"1990-01-15","reference_numbers":"REF123456","ftin_not_legally_required":false,"has_signed_and_certified":true,"signature_timestamp":"2023-12-08T15:30:00Z","treaty_claim_is_eligible":true,"treaty_claim_i_certify_resident":true,"treaty_claim_rate_of_withholding":"10","treaty_claim_article_paragraph":"Article 12, Paragraph 1","treaty_claim_has_additional_conditions":false}
```
